detail.longDescription: So apparently the new Longhorn v2 storage engine requires pinning/dedicating cores to it. I had hoped to use Longhorn because of it's data locality feature. Is there any CSI that will say, pull all data before mount/container launch and then just sync back? I really really don't want to throw the perf of having a local SSD on each node out for networked volumes # Kubernetes # k8s
